answers.core:
This is a proposed improvement to how Godot handles lighting as a whole and touches parameters that from what I can tell are hardcoded. From what research I have done this would make it difficult, hacky or both to achieve via an add-on, and would be handled in a more elegant and maintainable manner via engine code.

This all of course comes with a caveat that code is not my strong suit, and there may be simpler solutions that I have not considered.
answers.workaround: If my guesswork is correct, this would ease a lot of lighting headaches for open-world 3D environments, so could potentially be used widely. It also affects a lot of what seem to be hardcoded parameters, so likely could not be scripted around.

title: Allow DirectionalLight3D to inherit modified values from sky_material
